metadata.name: Isaac CRT
metadata.description:
Isaac CRT adds CRT, LCD and VHS effects to The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+.
[b]Subscribing only adds an entry to the Mods menu. Download Isaac CRT separately to use the graphics effects.[/b]
[url=https://github.com/vici1129/isaac-crt/releases/tag/v1.0.0]Download Isaac CRT 1.0[/url] [url=https://github.com/vici1129/isaac-crt/blob/main/INSTALL.txt]Installation instructions[/url]
[i]Tip: Click and zoom in on the three full-screen screenshots. Scaled previews can hide the fine details.[/i]
[b]Controls[/b] F7: CRT Core / CRT Studio / LCD Light / LCD Strong / VHS / Off F6: Toggle curvature for CRT/VHS or ghosting for LCD.
